source.description: Source location, e.g. src/foo.cu:vecAdd or ops/rms.py:rms_kernel

source_lang.description: Original kernel language. Absent = cuda (backward compatible).

target_style.description: SYCL target style. Absent = plain-sycl. sycl-tla for tiled XMX-bound tensor algebra.

triton_constructs.description: e.g. block-ptr, masked-load, tl.dot, tl.sum, tl.atomic_add, autotune, num_stages, constexpr.

io_spec.description: Inputs/outputs: names, dtypes, shapes/sizes; for Triton also grid + meta-params.

loc.description: Lines of code migrated for this kernel. GENERATED by .sycl/scripts/loc.sh (`kernel <id>` / `all`) — measured in inventory (source side) and refreshed after migrate (SYCL side). Never hand-count: the script resolves each kernel symbol to its line span and excludes comments/blanks from `code`.

source.description: Original-kernel line counts. `code` (comments/blanks excluded) is the headline figure.

sycl.description: Line counts of the hand-written SYCL that replaced it (from `sycl_impl`).

source_files.description: Per-file breakdown incl. the resolved line spans.

source_spec.description: OPTIONAL hand-added specs (file, file:START-END, file:sym,sym) for sources the `source` field does not name — e.g. dev variants. Preserved across re-measurement.

sycl_spec.description: OPTIONAL hand-added SYCL specs, same forms. Preserved across re-measurement.

mirrored_sources.description: Originals found by same-basename mirroring of the SYCL files (dev/cuda/x.cu <- dev/sycl/x.cpp).

unresolved.description: Specs/symbols that could not be located — these lines are NOT counted; fix by adding source_spec.

crosscheck_source.description: Which original kernel validated the CPU oracle.

evidence.description: Run id of the cross-check record (evidence.sh record test ...). Required when crosscheck is pass/fail.

sycl_impl.description: Path to the SYCL implementation file.

evidence.description: REQUIRED whenever result is pass/fail: run id(s) of the test record(s) under .sycl/reports/evidence/test/<id>/. The record holds the exact command, raw log, exit code, measured error and tolerance. `evidence.sh verify` (E1) fails a pass with no record, or one whose process exited non-zero. See references/evidence-model.md.

REQUIRED for any populated baseline/optimized figure: run id(s) of the bench records holding the raw per-iteration samples, warm-up/iters policy, shape and env fingerprint. `verify` (E2) fails an unbacked figure; (E7) fails when the two ends ran on different machines.
